metas.title: HTML meta title for the /latest page. Shown in browser tab and search engine results.
metas.description: HTML meta description for the /latest page. Shown in search engine results below the title. Should mention all four ECOS criteria: efficiency, sustainability, accessibility, and security.

latest.breadcrumb: Breadcrumb label for the /latest page. Shown in the page navigation path. Single word, keep short.

metas.title: HTML meta title for the /best page. Shown in browser tab and search engine results.
metas.description: HTML meta description for the /best page. Shown in search engine results below the title. Should mention all four ECOS criteria: efficiency, sustainability, accessibility, and security.

best.breadcrumb: Breadcrumb label for the /best page. Shown in the page navigation path. Single word, keep short.

titles.best_10: Section heading. Shown above the compact top-10 table on the /best page and possibly on the homepage.
titles.latest_10: Section heading. Shown above the compact top-10 table on the /latest page and possibly on the homepage.
titles.best_many: Page heading or section heading. Shown above the full list of 100 highest-scoring URLs on the /best page.
titles.latest_many: Page heading or section heading. Shown above the full list of 100 most recent URLs on the /latest page.

table_captions.best_10: Table caption for the compact top-10 best-scoring table. Describes the sort order and score range.
table_captions.latest_10: Table caption for the compact top-10 most recent table. Describes the sort order and score range.
table_captions.best_many: Table caption for the full 100-row best-scoring table. Describes the sort order and score range.
table_captions.latest_many: Table caption for the full 100-row most recent table. Describes the sort order and score range.

table_labels.position: Table column header. Labels the rank or position column. Keep short — one word.
table_labels.date: Table column header. Labels the audit date column. Keep short — one word.
table_labels.domain: Table column header. Labels the domain name column. Keep short — one word.
table_labels.scores: Table column group header. Labels the group of score columns (total + four ECOS categories).
table_labels.score_main: Table column header. Labels the total ECOS score column.
table_labels.score_e: Table column header. Labels the Efficiency sub-score column. This is one of the four ECOS categories.
table_labels.score_c: Table column header. Labels the Clean sub-score column. This is one of the four ECOS categories. 'Clean' is the official ECOS term — keep or translate consistently.
table_labels.score_o: Table column header. Labels the Open sub-score column. This is one of the four ECOS categories. 'Open' is the official ECOS term — keep or translate consistently.
table_labels.score_s: Table column header. Labels the Safe sub-score column. This is one of the four ECOS categories. 'Safe' is the official ECOS term — keep or translate consistently.
table_labels.url_page: Table column header. Labels the column showing the link to the audited website itself.
table_labels.url_audit_report: Table column header. Labels the column showing the link to the audit result page.
table_labels.to_audit: Table cell link label. Shown as the clickable text in each row to open the audit report. Keep short.

link_labels.best_many_audits: Link label. Shown below the compact top-10 table on the /best page or homepage. Links to the full list of 100 highest-scoring URLs.
link_labels.latest_many_audits: Link label. Shown below the compact top-10 table on the /latest page or homepage. Links to the full list of 100 most recent audits.

audit_lists.today: Table cell value. Shown in the date column when an audit was performed on the current day. Single word.
